links.outcome: Real-time stroke voice system accuracy in clinical trial and WeChat mini-program tests versus offline results
links.effect: Among 34 subjects, sustained vowels achieved 85.29% accuracy (four patients misclassified, one undetermined); two-stage strategy (SVs then SS) achieved 100% overall accuracy.
links.quote: Results demonstrated that among 34 subjects (24 patients and 10 healthy individuals), SVs achieved 85.29 % accuracy, with four patients misclassified and one patient undetermined.

unlisted_practices: Speech enhancement (denoising) preprocessing to improve robustness of speech-based diagnostic AI to environmental noise, with ~10% performance gain
Two-stage cascaded recognition strategy (sustained vowels followed by spontaneous speech) to improve diagnostic accuracy

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a speech-based early stroke diagnosis tool (including testing via clinical trials and a WeChat mini-program on 34 subjects), focusing on model performance with audio enhancement rather than comparing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
